Nursing School Tracker

Nursing Program Explorer

Every pre-licensure and graduate nursing program in one table, scored on what happens after graduation and on how well each one opens the door to CRNA, NP and PA. Track each program through the pipeline — should apply, applied, waitlisted, accepted — and the charts keep your list visible against the national field.

Every column, plotted

One square chart per measure: the bars are how many programs fall in each range, and every program you are tracking sits on top of its own bar in its stage colour. Hover a dot for the school, or a bar for its range and count. Drag across any chart to lasso a range — the schools inside it are listed by name below, and stay outlined on every other chart so you can see where that same group lands on cost, debt or NCLEX. Filter under 300 programs and every program becomes its own hoverable dot. Gaps are real: a cohort under ten completers is privacy-suppressed by the Department of Education, and a suppressed figure is missing, not zero.
